source: Hand-built HTML comp panel-note.html, captured with Playwright at 320px and 480px (no image generation available).
intent: Converge the panel on the card's note language: white ground, dashed unfilled note under a dark STANDBY INSIGHTS tab around the unit header and calendar; prices, facts and location follow as quieter dashed-ruled sections. Monospace for tabs, labels, dates, prices and grid numerals; system sans for caveat prose. Petrol palette, Archivo and outline icons dropped. Wording, element order and states unchanged from render.js.
usage: Development-only design reference. Illustrative data, not a live result. No raster from this comp ships in the panel.
